what_it_does: NOW, left panel: the hero shows 'Columbus.' in huge Bricolage with an orange period, then '22 St & 21 St', then '25 doors. 4-7:30 PM', then the why line from NL.pick. Two buttons: Start the walk (goes to #knock) and Preview the drive. Behind the hero sits a faint knocker-ring glow.

NOW, stats: hail 1.64 in (MRMS), storm Aug 8 and '52 days ago' (SPC), drive 50 mi and about 55 min on US-30 (from ROUTE_BAKED, NE GIS tag). A 'Likely insured: high' line is marked as an area estimate with the Census tag, and its tooltip carries COPY's full explanation. It also shows 9,046 homes and 68% owner-lived.

NOW, the 7 AM brief has 4 numbered items, each with a source chip: the overnight headline; 'Checked' with 202 hail reports, 8,050 radar signatures and 25 storm days (counts from NLX); the newest hail (Sep 13 near Colon, 121 homes vs Columbus 9,046); and the backup zone (Omaha) with a 'Show on the map' button.

NOW, right panel: the 12 ranked zones in a compact list with a rank ring colored by hail, storm date, homes, score and a score bar. The Omaha everyday zone says 'other scale' and has a tooltip, so its 90.8 score doesn't confuse. Hovering a row makes its map ring pulse and shows a name tag on the map. Clicking a row makes the camera fly there and the row expand into facts (hail with its source, storm, homes, score, distance from HMP, likely-insured area estimate, why), plus Start the walk for #1 and 'Back to the plan' (Esc). Escape collapses the row and recenters the map.

NOW, dock: today's plan on a proportional 7 AM-8 PM day bar. It has segments for brief, follow-ups, prep, drive (striped) and the knock window (orange), plus a 'now 7:02' needle with leader lines down to 5 step cards. The steps are Brief ready (current, green dot), Follow-ups, Prep door cards + 3-day cancel forms EN/ES (Neb. law tag), Drive to Columbus (leave 2:55 PM, computed as knock start minus 55 min minus 10), and Knock 25 doors 4-7:30 PM. A container query hides the details (they become tooltips) when the dock is narrow, and on a phone the steps stack.

NOW, map: canvas zone rings glow by hail (they add up where zones cluster) with a spring landing; the pick is a breathing mk-ring pin. Rank pins for 2-11 appear at zoom 11.7 and above, and an '11 zones, Aug 8, 1.38 in' cluster label shows below that. The real ROUTE_BAKED drive is drawn Fremont to Columbus with mile ticks and '18 mi / 20 min' and '33 mi / 35 min' labels at North Bend and Schuyler, plus an HMP start chip. 'Preview the drive' (hover or click) sends a car pin along Route.atTime with its heading rotation and a live 'mi / min' label, and the driven trail is drawn in white. At close zoom the pick's walk streets show.

NOW entrance: A.nowAssemble(ctx) returns an unplayed Timeline and puts the view in its before-state. The camera drops into Columbus while the hero says 'Picking today's zone n/12' and shows each candidate's street and score as it lands. The 12 rings land in rank order while the rows arrive unsorted (west to east), each score rolling. The list then FLIP-sorts itself, the winner's street FLIPs from row #1 into the hero ('Columbus.' lands), the pick pin ripples, and stats count up. The camera pulls back while the route writes itself from Fremont with a glowing head and the ticks pop as it passes, then the day steps land and the 'now' needle rings. It can be skipped with Escape or by any row/map interaction; stop() snaps it to the final state; A.still jumps to the end. A.views.now.assemble is exported too, and the view listens to 'intro:handoff' (it replays if Now is on screen, otherwise the first enter plays it). Later visits get a short ring drop instead.

MONEY, left panel: title 'The path to $100,000', then 'by December 31, 2026 · 94 days, 66 knock days left' (from Funnel.plan). A canvas knocker ring has an outer hairline for money logged toward $100k ($0, no jobs yet, HMP tag) and an inner thick ring filled to the share of the pace his day covers (15%); it turns green when the plan fits. Next to it: 'Doors a day it takes' at 285 (rolling), '42 fit in your day', and a state chip 'Over your day: 6.8x' or 'Fits in your day' that rings out when the state flips.

MONEY, levers (saved per viewer with A.store 'money.levers'): commission per job slider from $300 to $5,000, starting at $1,300 and labeled 'example, set by HMP' (10% of a typical $13,000 claim, an industry figure, with the insurer-decides note in the tooltip and a bench tag); a close-rate stage segment (New rep 1% / Typical 2% / Experienced 3.5%, ilroofinginstitute tooltips); a hours-a-day slider showing about 42 doors at 12 an hour; and a knock-days-per-week segment (3-7).

MONEY, 'What would make it fit', one lever at a time: only hours = 23.8 h (more than a full day); only close rate = 6.8% (top performers reach 5%); only commission = $9,100 a job (HMP sets this); 7 days a week = 205 a day. Below that is 'A mix that fits' (Experienced, 7 h, 5 days, 82 doors a day); its 'Try this mix' button slides the levers there with every number rolling. There is also 'Back to today's numbers' and 'A plan, not a promise.'

MONEY, right panel: the reverse funnel runs Goal in commission $100,000 -> Paid jobs 77 (÷ $1,300, example) -> Contracts signed 77 (1:1 assumed) -> Inspections done 133 (58% sign) -> Inspections booked 188 (71% happen) -> Conversations 5,640 (1% of doors book) -> Doors knocked 18,800 (30% open) -> Doors a day 285 (over 66 knock days). Each step has a rate line with a bench source tag, a log-scale bar (scaleX transition), and a number that rolls from old to new on change. The note under it: industry figures, replaced after about 200 doors.

MONEY, dock: 'What it takes this week' shows 6 stats with source tags (doors 1,425, talks 428, booked 15, inspections 11, signed 6, hours 119), plus 'That is 285 doors a day, 5 days a week · your week holds 17.5 h of the 119 h it takes'. It goes to 3 columns when narrow.

MONEY, map (dim 0.5): every 2026 hail area is a ring sized by its Census homes (colored by hail, labels placed without collisions below each ring). A dashed orange ring at HMP Fremont is sized on the same scale for the doors the goal takes; it tweens smaller or larger as levers change, with an 18,800 label on its rim. The 12 ranked zones show as bright dots with a pin: '743 homes: 2.6 days at the goal's pace, 18 at yours'. Rings grow in on entrance and the funnel rows fall in.
build.tests: smoke.mjs --view now,money: ALL PASS (still mode and --motion mode), 40 and 24 clicks, 0 console errors, no horizontal scroll at 1440/1280/400, 0 long rAF frames. shoot.mjs: now + money at --theme both --lang both --still (1440), --w 1280 --h 800, --w 400 --h 860 --still, all ready:true, hscroll:false. Full-page 400px shots checked in EN and ES. Money lever interaction ('Try this mix') verified by screenshot: levers, funnel, ring (turns green), chip and map need-ring all update. Motion mid-shots of the Now assemble checked (camera in Columbus, rings landing, unsorted rows, candidate ticker, then the sort). Note: the motion-mode shoot (`--wait 7000`) now lands inside the other builder's new intro (ready:false after 36 s), so motion shots of Now were taken with a script that presses Escape to skip the intro first. Funnel self-test untouched and passing.
foundation_requests: shoot.mjs motion mode: it now waits through the full intro (ready:false after 36 s). Add a flag such as --skip-intro (press Escape, or ?intro=0) so view builders can take entrance motion shots.

The modeled hail field (A.world.hail.at) is flat at 1.38 in across all 11 Columbus zones (the area peak), so per-zone hail can't be told apart. If the engine exports a per-zone MRMS value in NL.zones (like pick.hail_in), Now would show it in the list and the ring colors.

Optional: pins could accept an 'avoid panels' hint. Canvas labels from view layers (Money's area labels) can still collide with the world's town labels such as OMAHA, because world labels only avoid DOM pins.
motion_moments: Now: the pick assembles. The camera drops into the Columbus swath, the 12 zone rings land in rank order with a spring, the rows arrive unsorted with rolling scores while the hero ticks 'Picking today's zone n/12' through each candidate, the list FLIP-sorts, #1's street FLIPs into the hero, the pick pin ripples, and the numbers roll. The camera pulls back as the US-30 route writes itself from Fremont with a glowing head and mile ticks popping, then the day's steps land and the 7:02 needle rings (A.nowAssemble).
Now: 'Preview the drive' sends a car along the real route, timed by road speed and rotating with its heading, with a live '24 mi · 26 min' label and the driven trail lit behind it.
Now: hovering a row pulses its map ring; clicking one flies the camera there and the row expands.

Money: each lever change rolls every funnel number from old to new, slides the log bars, sweeps the ring, flips the fits/over chip with a ring-out, and tweens the dashed 'doors the goal takes' ring on the map. 'Try this mix' slides the sliders into a plan that fits.
build.for_filthe: At the typical new-rep rates, the 12 ranked zones hold 743 homes. That is about 2.6 knock days at the goal's pace, or 18 at yours. After that the next storm area has to be ready to go, so a steady supply of fresh zones matters as much as close rate. The Money map pin says this.

findings.issue: Dragging a slider re-renders with live:true, and render() skips renderFixes when live. There is no 'change' listener, so 'What would make it fit' is never recomputed after a slider move. Reproduced: I moved hours to 10 and commission to $5,000 and the chip flipped to 'Fits in your day', yet the fix list still said 'Only hours 23.8 h, more than a full day…' and 'A mix that fits… Try this mix'. The 'Back to today's numbers' button also never appears after a drag.
findings.fix: Add inp.addEventListener('change', () => setL({}, {})) (a non-live render on release), or call renderFixes on a 150 ms debounce inside the live path. Re-run the check: drag, then assert the fix list matches the chip state.

findings.issue: v.mixTw.then(() => setL({hours:h1, commission:c1})) ignores the finished flag. When the user grabs a slider during the 700 ms mix slide, the input handler cancels the tween, the promise resolves false, and the levers snap back to the mix. Reproduced: I clicked Try this mix, then pressed Home on the hours slider, and hours ended at 7 h instead of 1 h.
findings.fix: Use v.mixTw.then((ok) => { if (ok && V === v) { setL(...); syncInputs(v); } }), and capture the tween in a local variable so a newer applyMix can't be clobbered by an older resolution.

findings.issue: While the hero says 'Picking today's zone 0/12', the answer is already on screen: the eyebrow shows 'RANK 1 OF 12 · SCORE 61.5', the stats show 1.64 in / Aug 8 / 50 mi, the likely-insured box shows Columbus 9,046, and brief item 01 says 'best zone is still Columbus: 22 St & 21 St' (see the m2500 and m7000 shots). The countUp at TLIFT+220 has nothing left to reveal. The signature moment spoils itself.
findings.fix: In preState, mark the eyebrow score/rank, the .now-statpane contents, the .now-ins box and brief item 01 as is-pending (or set them to '—'). Reveal them in the TLIFT / TLIFT+220 cues, and in finalState too.

findings.issue: The candidate ticker walks ZONES in rank order, so scores tick downward (61.5, 60.1 … 47.9) and the first candidate is already the winner, which leaves no search to watch. It then ends at 12/12 on 'Pierce St & S 137 Av 90.8', the Omaha everyday zone on another scale. That is the biggest number shown right before 'Columbus.' lands, and the Omaha ring isn't even in the camera frame. It reads as if Omaha won.
findings.fix: Tick candidates in the found (west-to-east geo) order, the same order the rows arrive in, and add a 'best so far' leader line that changes when a higher score arrives. Leave the everyday zone out of the ticker, or show it as '90.8 · other scale' in muted text before the storm zones.

findings.area: now / assemble fragility (js/now.js setHover L385, map:hover L211)
findings.issue: Any pointer movement over a landing ring on the map, or over the zone list, calls setHover → tl.skip(). At load the cursor usually sits over the map, so a small mouse move kills the 5-second showpiece before the sort, the FLIP or the route write. Moving down from 'Play the film' (top right) crosses the list and skips it too.
findings.fix: Skip only on intent: click, keyboard, wheel or drag (map:click, camera user-interrupt, escape). During the timeline, let hover just highlight the ring without calling skip().

findings.area: now / hail numbers disagree on one screen
findings.issue: The pick's stat says 1.64 in (MRMS) and the why line says 1.6-inch, but the map cluster label next to the same pin says '11 zones Aug 8 · 1.38 in', and each expanded row says 1.38 in 'model'. Two different hail sizes for the same place a few centimeters apart undercut the 'every number has a source' promise.
findings.fix: Label the cluster as a range with its source ('11 zones · Aug 8 · 1.38-1.64 in'), or show only the pick's MRMS value, and word the per-zone value as 'area model ~1.38 in'. The foundation request for per-zone MRMS in NL.zones is the real fix; until then, don't put both numbers side by side unexplained.

findings.issue: At the primary MacBook size the dock is only ~615 px wide, so the container query hides every step detail. The cards show only a time and a title, with empty space below. The 3-day cancel form EN/ES line with its Neb. law tag, the start address and '50 mi, about 55 min' exist only in tooltips. The leader-line SVG curves look like stray squiggles, not a designed connector.
findings.fix: Show a one-line short detail at 560-820 px (for example '25 cards · cancel forms EN+ES' with the law tag, '50 mi · 55 min', 'start 2xxx 22 St'), hiding only below ~560 px. Replace the bezier leads with straight vertical ticks from each segment's center down to its card, or drop them, and draw them with the step reveal instead of before it.

findings.area: money / hierarchy of the left panel
findings.issue: The most useful answer on the page, 'A mix that fits: Experienced · 7 h · 5 days · 82 doors a day' with its Try this mix button, sits below the fold of the left panel at 1440 and 1280. Only 'Only hours' and 'Only close rate' are visible. FilthE sees the problem (285 vs 42) but not the way out without scrolling.
findings.fix: Move the mix card directly under the 'Over your day: 6.8x' chip in .money-goal (or into the dock line), and keep the one-lever-at-a-time list below the levers.

findings.issue: The Omaha cluster is a heap of about 10 overlapping rings. The Money labels collide with the world's OMAHA and FREMONT labels. There are two 'Fremont' labels with different counts (7,669 and 5,318) and two Bellevue values across sizes, with nothing telling them apart. At 400 px, '18,800 doors the g…' and 'Omaha 17,60…' are clipped at the right edge. The dashed 18,800 ring, the map's one message, is lost in the noise.
findings.fix: Add the storm date to duplicate-name labels ('Fremont · Jun 12 · 7,669'), or merge areas by town. Drop area strokes to hairlines at 0.4 alpha so the dashed need ring dominates. Clamp pin labels to the map rect, and at 400 px fit the camera to [Columbus…Omaha] with the need label flipped to the left of the ring.

findings.area: now / ES day-bar hour labels (css/now.css .now-day__hours span)
findings.issue: The selector .now-day__hours span also matches the inner span.en and span.es that A.both() creates. The .es span, not being :first-child, gets an extra position:absolute plus translateX(-50%). In Spanish every hour label is shifted left, and '7 a. m.' hangs past the track start toward the pane edge (visible in the now ES shots).

At 1280 the drive step reads 'leave 2:5…' (ellipsis). At 400 the pick ring sits on the map's left edge with its glow cut, because camera pad l:30 is too tight for a 1.25x ring plus glow. In ES the hero's 'PUNTAJE 61.5 ENGINE' wraps onto its own line and TRAYECTO's source tag drops below the label, so the three stat headers no longer align.
findings.fix: Put 'leave' into the step title ('Drive to Columbus') and keep only '2:55 PM' in the time slot. Use stacked camera pad l ≥ 56. Let .now-stats .stat__k wrap consistently (tag always on its own line), or shorten the tag to 'GIS'.

findings.issue: The car's live '40 mi · 42 min' label collides with the Schuyler '33 mi / 35 min' tick and the '11 zones' cluster label. In headless captures the white driven trail lagged well behind the car pin (at 40 mi the trail ended near Schuyler; at 50 mi it stopped short of Columbus). This may be SwiftShader canvas lag, but it's worth checking on hardware.
findings.fix: Hide the tick pins the car has passed (or fade them to 0.3) while S.car is running, and offset the car label above the road. Verify that the trail and the pin draw in the same frame, e.g. by drawing the car in the canvas layer instead of as a DOM pin.

findings.issue: 'Columbus.' at letter-spacing -.052em makes the m, b and u touch at 86px, so it reads as a kerning error instead of a luxury tight setting.
findings.fix: Use -.04em (or -.045em with opsz 96) and check the 400 px shot.

findings.issue: The funnel mixes '58.0% of inspections sign' with '71%' and '30%'. The rate line '1% of doors book' sits between Conversations and Inspections booked, where the actual ratio is 3.3%, which is easy to misread. The Spanish 'Pasa tu día: 6.8×' is awkward. The ring needs a two-line legend to be understood.
findings.fix: Round to 58%. Reword that step as '1% of doors (3.3% of talks) book'. Use 'Se pasa de tu día: 6.8×' or '6.8× tu día'. Put 'OF THE PACE' plus a small '$0 logged' caption inside or around the ring and drop the legend.

findings.issue: My smoke run found long rAF frames on Now (still: 1 at 289 ms; motion: 2 at 877 and 1158 ms), though the report said 0. .now-z transitions background-color, but contract rule 8 says to animate only transform/opacity. Faint 9.5-10 px text ('written 7:02 AM', hour labels, OTHER SCALE) is low contrast in the light theme.
findings.fix: Profile the first assemble frame (flyTo + 12 radial gradients + FLIP getBoundingClientRect) and find where the ~1 s frame comes from. Swap the row hover background for an opacity-faded ::before. Move the micro labels from --faint to --muted in light mode.

review.best_thing: Keep the Now left-panel hero. 'Columbus.' has the orange period, then the street, then '25 doors. 4-7:30 PM' and a plain why-line, with one orange 'Start the walk' button. Below it, every number carries its source chip (MRMS, SPC, NE GIS, Census area estimate). It passes the 5-second test in both themes and both languages, and it looks like a product, not a template. Pair it with the real US-30 route and its '18 mi / 20 min' and '33 mi / 35 min' ticks. On Money, keep the honest '285 doors a day it takes / 42 fit in your day' answer with its levers.
